## Specification

### Component: DatePicker and DateRangePicker

An input-like field that opens our `Calendar` in a popover. `DatePicker` picks one day; `DateRangePicker` picks a start and an end with presets. Both reuse `Calendar` and its date helpers (`startOfDay`, `addDays`, `dateKey`, `DateRange`…): plain `Date` objects at local midnight, no date library. Dates are formatted with `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

#### Anatomy
```
<DatePicker>                  <div class="ui-picker-field ui-datepicker"> looks like an Input; sizes sm 32 · md 36 · lg 44
  <button.ui-picker-trigger>  calendar icon + .ui-picker-value (formatted date, or the placeholder)
    -- or, with `typeable` --
  <input.ui-picker-input>     text, parsed on Enter / blur
  <button.ui-input-action>    clear (x), only while there is a value; with `typeable` also the calendar button
  <input type="hidden">       name → ISO yyyy-mm-dd
  <PickerPanel>               popover="manual", role="dialog", class ui-picker-panel
    <Calendar mode="single">

<DateRangePicker>             same field; trigger shows "Nov 3 – Nov 24, 2026"
  <PickerPanel.ui-daterange-panel>
    .ui-daterange
      .ui-daterange-presets   role="group", buttons .ui-daterange-preset[aria-pressed]
      .ui-daterange-main      <Calendar mode="range" numberOfMonths 2 | 1> + optional .ui-daterange-footer
  <input type="hidden">       startName / endName → ISO yyyy-mm-dd
```

#### Props
- `DatePicker`: `value` / `defaultValue` (`Date | null`), `onValueChange(Date | null)`, `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`, `locale` (default `en-US`), `format` (Intl.DateTimeFormat options, default `{ month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }`), `placeholder` (default "Pick a date"), `clearable` (default true), `typeable`, `min`, `max`, `disabledDates` (list or predicate), `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `id`, `size`, `today`, `clearLabel`, `openLabel`, `panelLabel`, `calendarProps` (`weekStartsOn`, `previousLabel`, `nextLabel`, `showOutsideDays`, `numberOfMonths`). Native div props go to the field.
- `DateRangePicker`: `value` / `defaultValue` (`{ from: Date | null, to: Date | null }`), `onValueChange(range)`, `presets` (`DateRangePreset[] | false`; default Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, This year), `confirm` (Apply / Cancel footer), `startName`, `endName`, plus the same `locale`, `format`, `placeholder` ("Pick a date range"), `clearable`, `min`, `max`, `disabledDates`, `disabled`, `required`, `id`, `size`, `today`, labels, `calendarProps`.
- `DateRangePreset`: `{ label: string; range: (today: Date) => { from: Date; to: Date } }`.
- Inside a `<Field>` both pick up the id (the `<Label>` targets the trigger or the text input), `aria-describedby`, invalid, required and disabled state.

#### Behaviour
- DatePicker: clicking the field (or ArrowDown on it) opens the popover and moves focus to the selected day (else today). Picking a day sets the value, closes the popover and returns focus to the field. Esc and an outside click close it without a change; tabbing out closes it. Clicking the clear button empties the value and keeps focus on the field.
- `typeable`: the text is parsed on Enter and on blur. Accepted: ISO (`2026-11-24`), numeric in the locale's day/month order (`11/24/2026`, `24.11.2026`, two-digit years mean 20xx), month names (`Nov 24`, `24 November 2026`, year optional). A parse that fails, or a date outside `min`/`max`/`disabledDates`, sets `aria-invalid` and keeps the text. An empty field clears the value. Esc with the popover closed reverts the text. ArrowDown opens the popover.
- DateRangePicker: the first pick starts a range, the second completes it (either order); the range commits and the popover closes on the second pick. With `confirm`, nothing commits until Apply; Cancel, Esc and an outside click discard the draft. Presets set the whole range at once (committing unless `confirm`) and jump the calendar to its start; a preset entirely outside `min`/`max` is disabled, others are clamped to them. The preset matching the current range has `aria-pressed="true"`. Apply stays disabled until both dates are picked.
- Two months show side by side from 640px, one month below. On phones the presets become a horizontally scrolling row above the calendar.
- Hidden inputs are disabled with the control, so a disabled picker submits nothing.

#### Visual rules
- The field matches Input: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-md`, `--ui-background` (5% foreground tint in dark), `--ui-shadow-xs`; hover darkens the border; open or keyboard-focused shows `--ui-ring` border and a 3px ring; invalid uses `--ui-destructive`; disabled 50% opacity.
- Calendar icon 16px `--ui-muted-foreground`; placeholder `--ui-muted-foreground`; value `tabular-nums`, single line with ellipsis.
- Panel: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-shadow-lg`, no padding of its own (the Calendar pads), `width: max-content`, `max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem)`; opens 6px below the field, left-aligned, flips when there is no room.
- Presets column 152px min, 12px padding, 1px divider; presets 32px tall (44px on touch), `--radius-md`, hover and pressed use `--ui-accent`.
- Footer: top 1px `--ui-border`, 12px padding; the summary is 13px, muted until complete; Cancel is a ghost small Button, Apply a primary small Button.
- Below 360px the day cells shrink to `(100vw − 56px) / 7` so seven columns always fit.

#### Motion
- Panel enters with `ui-pop-in` (220ms, `--ui-ease-out`, 4px rise from the field, scale .96, 2px blur) and leaves with `ui-pop-out` (160ms, `--ui-ease-in`).
- Field border and ring change in `--ui-duration-fast`; the trigger itself does not scale (it opens a popup).
- Reduced motion: the panel only fades.

#### Accessibility
- The trigger is a `<button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded aria-controls>`; its visible value is referenced by `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader hears "Due date, button, Nov 24, 2026".
- The panel is a non-modal `role="dialog"` with `aria-label`; the Calendar inside follows the APG date-grid pattern (see Calendar).
- Typed input is a plain text input with `aria-invalid`.
- Clear and calendar buttons have `aria-label`s.

#### Acceptance checks
- Click opens the panel under the field with focus on a day; Esc closes it and focus returns to the field.
- Picking a day shows it formatted in the field, writes `yyyy-mm-dd` to the hidden input and closes the panel.
- Typing `11/24/2026` then Enter selects Nov 24, 2026; typing `31/02/2026` sets `aria-invalid="true"`.
- Days outside `min`/`max` cannot be picked or typed.
- Range: two clicks produce "Nov 3 – Nov 24, 2026" and two hidden values; presets fill it in one click; with `confirm` Cancel changes nothing.
- 390px wide: one month, presets scroll sideways, nothing overflows the viewport.
- Works inside a `<Field>`: the label focuses the control; an error sets the invalid border.

### `ui/components/date-picker/date-input.ts`

```ts
import { startOfDay } from '../calendar/date-utils';
import type { DateRange } from '../calendar/selection';

/** Default display format: "Nov 24, 2026". */
export const DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' };

/** Format a date with Intl. `format` takes any Intl.DateTimeFormat options. */
export function formatPickerDate(date: Date, locale = 'en-US', format: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, format).format(date);
}

/**
 * Format a range: "Nov 3 – Nov 24, 2026". Inside one year the first date drops
 * the year; across years both keep it. A range with only a start shows "Nov 3 –".
 */
export function formatPickerDateRange(
  range: DateRange | null | undefined,
  locale = 'en-US',
  format: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT,
): string {
  if (!range?.from) return '';
  if (!range.to) return `${formatPickerDate(range.from, locale, format)} –`;
  const { from, to } = range;
  if (format.year && !format.dateStyle && from.getFullYear() === to.getFullYear()) {
    const withoutYear: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { ...format };
    delete withoutYear.year;
    return `${formatPickerDate(from, locale, withoutYear)} – ${formatPickerDate(to, locale, format)}`;
  }
  return `${formatPickerDate(from, locale, format)} – ${formatPickerDate(to, locale, format)}`;
}

type Part = 'd' | 'm' | 'y';

/** The order a locale writes day, month and year in, e.g. ['m','d','y'] for en-US. */
export function getDateOrder(locale = 'en-US'): Part[] {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' }).formatToParts(
    new Date(2000, 10, 25),
  );
  const order: Part[] = [];
  for (const p of parts) {
    if (p.type === 'day') order.push('d');
    else if (p.type === 'month') order.push('m');
    else if (p.type === 'year') order.push('y');
  }
  return order.length === 3 ? order : ['m', 'd', 'y'];
}

/** A real calendar date from parts, or null when it would roll over (31 Feb) or the year is absurd. */
function makeDate(y: number, m: number, d: number): Date | null {
  if (!Number.isInteger(y) || !Number.isInteger(m) || !Number.isInteger(d) || y < 1 || y > 9999) return null;
  const date = new Date(2000, 0, 1);
  date.setFullYear(y, m - 1, d);
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return date.getFullYear() === y && date.getMonth() === m - 1 && date.getDate() === d ? date : null;
}

const fullYear = (raw: string): number => (raw.length <= 2 ? 2000 + Number(raw) : Number(raw));

const normalise = (s: string) =>
  s
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[̀-ͯ.]/g, '');

function monthLookup(locale: string): Map<string, number> {
  const map = new Map<string, number>();
  const locales = locale === 'en-US' ? [locale] : [locale, 'en-US'];
  for (const loc of locales) {
    for (const style of ['long', 'short'] as const) {
      const fmt = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(loc, { month: style });
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const name = normalise(fmt.format(new Date(2000, i, 1)));
        if (!map.has(name)) map.set(name, i + 1);
        // "sept" for "september"
        if (style === 'long' && name.length > 4 && !map.has(name.slice(0, 4))) map.set(name.slice(0, 4), i + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Parse what a person types into a date, or null when it is not a real date.
 * Accepts ISO (2026-11-24), numeric in the locale's order (11/24/2026, 24.11.2026,
 * 24-11-26) and month names (Nov 24 2026, 24 November 2026, Nov 24, 26).
 * A missing year means the current year. Two-digit years mean 20xx.
 */
export function parsePickerDate(input: string, locale = 'en-US', today: Date = new Date()): Date | null {
  const text = input.trim();
  if (!text) return null;
  const currentYear = startOfDay(today).getFullYear();

  // ISO-like: year first with four digits
  const iso = /^(\d{4})[-/.\s](\d{1,2})[-/.\s](\d{1,2})$/.exec(text);
  if (iso) return makeDate(Number(iso[1]), Number(iso[2]), Number(iso[3]));

  // Month name anywhere: "Nov 24, 2026" / "24 November 2026"
  const tokens = text.split(/[\s,./-]+/).filter(Boolean);
  const months = monthLookup(locale);
  const nameIndex = tokens.findIndex((t) => /\D/.test(t) && months.has(normalise(t)));
  if (nameIndex !== -1) {
    const month = months.get(normalise(tokens[nameIndex]!))!;
    const numbers = tokens.filter((_, i) => i !== nameIndex);
    if (numbers.length < 1 || numbers.length > 2 || numbers.some((n) => !/^\d{1,4}$/.test(n))) return null;
    const yearToken = numbers.find((n) => n.length === 4);
    const rest = numbers.filter((n) => n !== yearToken);
    if (yearToken && rest.length === 1) return makeDate(Number(yearToken), month, Number(rest[0]));
    if (!yearToken && rest.length === 1) return makeDate(currentYear, month, Number(rest[0]));
    if (!yearToken && rest.length === 2) return makeDate(fullYear(rest[1]!), month, Number(rest[0]));
    return null;
  }

  // Numeric: three groups split by / . - or spaces, in the locale's order
  const nums = /^(\d{1,4})[-/.\s]+(\d{1,2})[-/.\s]+(\d{1,4})$/.exec(text);
  if (nums) {
    const raw = [nums[1]!, nums[2]!, nums[3]!];
    const order = getDateOrder(locale);
    const values: Record<Part, string> = { d: '', m: '', y: '' };
    // The four-digit group is the year wherever it sits; the others follow the locale order
    const yearAt = raw.findIndex((r) => r.length === 4);
    if (yearAt !== -1) {
      values.y = raw[yearAt]!;
      const others = order.filter((p) => p !== 'y');
      const left = raw.filter((_, i) => i !== yearAt);
      values[others[0]!] = left[0]!;
      values[others[1]!] = left[1]!;
    } else {
      order.forEach((p, i) => {
        values[p] = raw[i]!;
      });
    }
    return makeDate(fullYear(values.y), Number(values.m), Number(values.d));
  }

  // Day and month only: "24/11" in the locale's order, current year
  const short = /^(\d{1,2})[-/.]+(\d{1,2})$/.exec(text);
  if (short) {
    const order = getDateOrder(locale).filter((p) => p !== 'y');
    const values: Record<string, string> = {};
    order.forEach((p, i) => {
      values[p] = [short[1]!, short[2]!][i]!;
    });
    return makeDate(currentYear, Number(values.m), Number(values.d));
  }
  return null;
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,

  useId,

  type KeyboardEvent,
} from 'react';

import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { Calendar, type CalendarSingleProps } from '../calendar/calendar';
import { dateKey, isAfter, isBefore, matchesDate, startOfDay, type DateMatcher } from '../calendar/date-utils';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { formatPickerDate, parsePickerDate } from './date-input';
import { PickerPanel } from './picker-panel';

export type PickerSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

/** Calendar options a picker passes through. */
export type PickerCalendarProps = Partial<
  Pick<CalendarSingleProps, 'weekStartsOn' | 'previousLabel' | 'nextLabel' | 'showOutsideDays' | 'numberOfMonths'>
>;

export interface DatePickerProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'placeholder'> {
  /** Selected date (controlled). `null` means empty. */
  value?: Date | null;
  defaultValue?: Date | null;
  onValueChange?: (value: Date | null) => void;
  /** Controlled open state of the calendar popover. */
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** BCP 47 tag for the formatted value and the calendar. Default `en-US`. */
  locale?: string;
  /** Intl.DateTimeFormat options for the shown value. Default "Nov 24, 2026". */
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions;
  /** Shown while empty. Default "Pick a date". */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Show a clear button once there is a value. Default true. */
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Let people type the date ("11/24/2026", "Nov 24") as well as pick it. */
  typeable?: boolean;
  /** Earliest selectable date. */
  min?: Date;
  /** Latest selectable date. */
  max?: Date;
  /** Dates that cannot be picked: a list, or a function returning true to disable. */
  disabledDates?: DateMatcher;
  /** Disable the whole control. */
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Submitted with a form as an ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) through a hidden input. */
  name?: string;
  /** Id of the trigger (or the text input when `typeable`). Inside a <Field> it follows the label. */
  id?: string;
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: PickerSize;
  /** Treat this as "today" (tests, demos). */
  today?: Date;
  /** Accessible names. */
  clearLabel?: string;
  openLabel?: string;
  panelLabel?: string;
  calendarProps?: PickerCalendarProps;
}

/**
 * DatePicker — an input-like field that opens our Calendar. Picking a day
 * closes the popover. With `typeable` the text can be edited too: it is parsed
 * on Enter or blur and flagged invalid when it is not a real, allowed date.
 */
export const DatePicker = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DatePickerProps>(function DatePicker(props, forwardedRef) {
  const {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = false,
    onOpenChange,
    locale = 'en-US',
    format,
    placeholder = 'Pick a date',
    clearable = true,
    typeable = false,
    min,
    max,
    disabledDates,
    disabled,
    required,
    name,
    id,
    size = 'md',
    today: todayProp,
    clearLabel = 'Clear date',
    openLabel = 'Choose date',
    panelLabel = 'Choose date',
    calendarProps,
    className,
    'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
    'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
    ...rest
  } = props;

  const uid = useId();
  const panelId = `${uid}-panel`;
  const valueId = `${uid}-value`;
  const fieldRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, fieldRef);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const focusRef = typeable ? inputRef : triggerRef;

  const control = useFieldControl(
    { id, required, disabled, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid },
    !typeable && valueId,
  );
  const isDisabled = !!control.disabled;

  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<Date | null>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? null,
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [openState, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const open = openState && !isDisabled;

  const today = useMemo(() => startOfDay(todayProp ?? new Date()), [todayProp]);
  const blocked = (d: Date) =>
    (!!min && isBefore(d, min)) || (!!max && isAfter(d, max)) || matchesDate(d, disabledDates);

  // Typed text: null while the field just shows the formatted value
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [typedInvalid, setTypedInvalid] = useState(false);
  const valueKey = value ? dateKey(value) : '';
  useEffect(() => {
    // The value changed from outside (clear, a pick, the parent): drop stale typing
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) {
      setText(null);
      setTypedInvalid(false);
    }
  }, [valueKey]);

  const commitText = () => {
    if (text === null) return;
    if (!text.trim()) {
      setValue(null);
      setText(null);
      setTypedInvalid(false);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parsePickerDate(text, locale, today);
    if (parsed && !blocked(parsed)) {
      setValue(parsed);
      setText(null);
      setTypedInvalid(false);
    } else {
      setTypedInvalid(true);
    }
  };

  const pick = (d: Date | null) => {
    setValue(d);
    setText(null);
    setTypedInvalid(false);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const clear = () => {
    setValue(null);
    setText(null);
    setTypedInvalid(false);
    focusRef.current?.focus();
  };

  const formatted = value ? formatPickerDate(value, locale, format) : '';
  const invalid = typedInvalid || (!!control['aria-invalid'] && control['aria-invalid'] !== 'false');
  const showClear = clearable && !isDisabled && (!!value || (typeable && !!text));

  const popupProps = {
    'aria-haspopup': 'dialog' as const,
    'aria-expanded': open,
    'aria-controls': open ? panelId : undefined,
  };

  const onTypedKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setOpen(true);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (open) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      commitText();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && !open && text !== null) {
      setText(null);
      setTypedInvalid(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-picker-field ui-datepicker', size !== 'md' && `ui-picker-field-${size}`, className)}
      data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-disabled={isDisabled || undefined}
      data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
      {...rest}
    >
      {typeable ? (
        <>
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="text"
            className="ui-picker-input"
            id={control.id}
            value={text ?? formatted}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            disabled={isDisabled}
            required={control.required}
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            aria-label={ariaLabel}
            aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
            aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
            aria-invalid={invalid || undefined}
            onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
              setText(e.target.value);
              setTypedInvalid(false);
            }}
            onBlur={commitText}
            onKeyDown={onTypedKeyDown}
          />
          {showClear && (
            <button type="button" className="ui-input-action" aria-label={clearLabel} onClick={clear}>
              <Icon name="x" />
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            ref={triggerRef}
            type="button"
            className="ui-input-action"
            aria-label={openLabel}
            disabled={isDisabled}
            data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
            onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            {...popupProps}
          >
            <Icon name="calendar" />
          </button>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <button
            ref={triggerRef}
            type="button"
            className="ui-picker-trigger"
            id={control.id}
            disabled={isDisabled}
            aria-label={ariaLabel}
            aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
            aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
            data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
            onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                e.preventDefault();
                setOpen(true);
              }
            }}
            {...popupProps}
          >
            <Icon name="calendar" className="ui-picker-icon" />
            <span id={valueId} className="ui-picker-value" data-placeholder={!value || undefined}>
              {value ? formatted : placeholder}
            </span>
          </button>
          {showClear && (
            <button type="button" className="ui-input-action" aria-label={clearLabel} onClick={clear}>
              <Icon name="x" />
            </button>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={valueKey} disabled={isDisabled} />}

      <PickerPanel
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        anchorRef={fieldRef}
        returnFocusRef={focusRef}
        id={panelId}
        aria-label={panelLabel}
        focusSelector='.ui-calendar-day[tabindex="0"]'
      >
        <Calendar
          mode="single"
          value={value}
          onValueChange={pick}
          locale={locale}
          min={min}
          max={max}
          disabled={disabledDates}
          today={todayProp}
          {...calendarProps}
        />
      </PickerPanel>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/date-picker/date-range-panel.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useMediaQuery } from '../../hooks/use-media-query';
import { Button } from '../button';
import { Calendar } from '../calendar/calendar';
import { clampDate, isAfter, isBefore, isSameDay, startOfDay, startOfMonth, type DateMatcher } from '../calendar/date-utils';
import type { DateRange } from '../calendar/selection';
import { formatPickerDateRange } from './date-input';
import { isCompleteRange, type DateRangePreset } from './date-range-presets';
import type { PickerCalendarProps } from './date-picker';

export interface DateRangePanelProps {
  value: DateRange;
  /** Wait for Apply instead of committing when the second date is picked. */
  confirm: boolean;
  presets: DateRangePreset[];
  /** Start of today, for presets. */
  today: Date;
  /** The `today` prop as given, passed on to the Calendar. */
  todayProp?: Date;
  locale: string;
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions;
  min?: Date;
  max?: Date;
  disabledDates?: DateMatcher;
  calendarProps?: PickerCalendarProps;
  onCommit: (range: DateRange) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  applyLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  presetsLabel: string;
  /** Footer hint while the end date is still missing. */
  pendingLabel: string;
}

/**
 * The inside of the range picker's popover: presets, a Calendar in range mode
 * (two months on wide screens, one on phones) and an optional Apply / Cancel
 * footer. It holds the draft range, so closing the panel discards it.
 */
export function DateRangePanel({
  value,
  confirm,
  presets,
  today,
  todayProp,
  locale,
  format,
  min,
  max,
  disabledDates,
  calendarProps,
  onCommit,
  onCancel,
  applyLabel,
  cancelLabel,
  presetsLabel,
  pendingLabel,
}: DateRangePanelProps) {
  const wide = useMediaQuery('(min-width: 640px)');
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<DateRange>(value);
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(() => startOfMonth(value.from ?? today));

  const resolve = (preset: DateRangePreset) => {
    const raw = preset.range(today);
    return {
      from: clampDate(startOfDay(raw.from), min, max),
      to: clampDate(startOfDay(raw.to), min, max),
      available: !(max && isAfter(raw.from, max)) && !(min && isBefore(raw.to, min)),
    };
  };

  const choosePreset = (preset: DateRangePreset) => {
    const { from, to } = resolve(preset);
    const next = { from, to };
    setDraft(next);
    setMonth(startOfMonth(from));
    if (!confirm) onCommit(next);
  };

  const onCalendarChange = (next: DateRange) => {
    setDraft(next);
    if (!confirm && next.from && next.to) onCommit(next);
  };

  const complete = isCompleteRange(draft);

  return (
    <div className="ui-daterange">
      {presets.length > 0 && (
        <div className="ui-daterange-presets" role="group" aria-label={presetsLabel}>
          {presets.map((preset) => {
            const r = resolve(preset);
            const active = !!draft.from && !!draft.to && isSameDay(draft.from, r.from) && isSameDay(draft.to, r.to);
            return (
              <button
                key={preset.label}
                type="button"
                className="ui-daterange-preset"
                aria-pressed={active}
                disabled={!r.available}
                onClick={() => choosePreset(preset)}
              >
                {preset.label}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="ui-daterange-main">
        <Calendar
          mode="range"
          value={draft}
          onValueChange={onCalendarChange}
          month={month}
          onMonthChange={setMonth}
          numberOfMonths={wide ? 2 : 1}
          locale={locale}
          min={min}
          max={max}
          disabled={disabledDates}
          today={todayProp}
          {...calendarProps}
        />
        {confirm && (
          <div className="ui-daterange-footer">
            <span className="ui-daterange-summary" aria-live="polite" data-empty={!complete || undefined}>
              {complete ? formatPickerDateRange(draft, locale, format) : draft.from ? pendingLabel : ''}
            </span>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onCancel}>
              {cancelLabel}
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" disabled={!complete} onClick={() => onCommit(draft)}>
              {applyLabel}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useId, useMemo, useRef, type HTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { dateKey, startOfDay, type DateMatcher } from '../calendar/date-utils';
import { emptyRange, type DateRange } from '../calendar/selection';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { formatPickerDateRange } from './date-input';
import type { PickerCalendarProps, PickerSize } from './date-picker';
import { DateRangePanel } from './date-range-panel';
import { defaultDateRangePresets, type DateRangePreset } from './date-range-presets';
import { PickerPanel } from './picker-panel';

export interface DateRangePickerProps
  extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'placeholder'> {
  /** Selected range (controlled). */
  value?: DateRange;
  defaultValue?: DateRange;
  onValueChange?: (value: DateRange) => void;
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** BCP 47 tag for the formatted value and the calendar. Default `en-US`. */
  locale?: string;
  /** Intl.DateTimeFormat options for each date. Default "Nov 3 – Nov 24, 2026". */
  format?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions;
  /** Shown while empty. Default "Pick a date range". */
  placeholder?: string;
  clearable?: boolean;
  /** Shortcuts shown beside the calendar. `false` or `[]` hides them. Default: Today … This year. */
  presets?: DateRangePreset[] | false;
  /** Add Apply / Cancel: nothing is committed until Apply. Default false (commits on the second pick). */
  confirm?: boolean;
  min?: Date;
  max?: Date;
  disabledDates?: DateMatcher;
  disabled?: boolean;
  required?: boolean;
  /** Hidden-input names; each submits an ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd). */
  startName?: string;
  endName?: string;
  id?: string;
  size?: PickerSize;
  today?: Date;
  clearLabel?: string;
  panelLabel?: string;
  applyLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  presetsLabel?: string;
  pendingLabel?: string;
  calendarProps?: PickerCalendarProps;
}

/**
 * DateRangePicker — an input-like field that opens a range calendar with
 * presets. Two months side by side on wide screens, one on phones. By default
 * the range commits when the second date is picked; `confirm` adds Apply / Cancel.
 */
export const DateRangePicker = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, DateRangePickerProps>(function DateRangePicker(props, forwardedRef) {
  const {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onValueChange,
    open: openProp,
    defaultOpen = false,
    onOpenChange,
    locale = 'en-US',
    format,
    placeholder = 'Pick a date range',
    clearable = true,
    presets = defaultDateRangePresets,
    confirm = false,
    min,
    max,
    disabledDates,
    disabled,
    required,
    startName,
    endName,
    id,
    size = 'md',
    today: todayProp,
    clearLabel = 'Clear dates',
    panelLabel = 'Choose a date range',
    applyLabel = 'Apply',
    cancelLabel = 'Cancel',
    presetsLabel = 'Presets',
    pendingLabel = 'Select an end date',
    calendarProps,
    className,
    'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy,
    'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': ariaLabelledBy,
    ...rest
  } = props;

  const uid = useId();
  const panelId = `${uid}-panel`;
  const valueId = `${uid}-value`;
  const fieldRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, fieldRef);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);

  const control = useFieldControl(
    { id, required, disabled, 'aria-describedby': ariaDescribedBy, 'aria-invalid': ariaInvalid },
    valueId,
  );
  const isDisabled = !!control.disabled;

  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<DateRange>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? emptyRange(),
    onChange: onValueChange,
  });
  const [openState, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const open = openState && !isDisabled;

  const today = useMemo(() => startOfDay(todayProp ?? new Date()), [todayProp]);
  const presetList = presets === false ? [] : presets;

  const text = formatPickerDateRange(value, locale, format);
  const invalid = !!control['aria-invalid'] && control['aria-invalid'] !== 'false';
  const showClear = clearable && !isDisabled && !!value.from;

  const commit = (range: DateRange) => {
    setValue(range);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-picker-field ui-daterangepicker', size !== 'md' && `ui-picker-field-${size}`, className)}
      data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-disabled={isDisabled || undefined}
      data-invalid={invalid || undefined}
      {...rest}
    >
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        className="ui-picker-trigger"
        id={control.id}
        disabled={isDisabled}
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        aria-labelledby={ariaLabelledBy}
        aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={open ? panelId : undefined}
        data-state={open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
            e.preventDefault();
            setOpen(true);
          }
        }}
      >
        <Icon name="calendar" className="ui-picker-icon" />
        <span id={valueId} className="ui-picker-value" data-placeholder={!text || undefined}>
          {text || placeholder}
        </span>
      </button>
      {showClear && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className="ui-input-action"
          aria-label={clearLabel}
          onClick={() => {
            setValue(emptyRange());
            triggerRef.current?.focus();
          }}
        >
          <Icon name="x" />
        </button>
      )}

      {startName && <input type="hidden" name={startName} value={value.from ? dateKey(value.from) : ''} disabled={isDisabled} />}
      {endName && <input type="hidden" name={endName} value={value.to ? dateKey(value.to) : ''} disabled={isDisabled} />}

      <PickerPanel
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        anchorRef={fieldRef}
        returnFocusRef={triggerRef}
        id={panelId}
        aria-label={panelLabel}
        className="ui-daterange-panel"
        focusSelector='.ui-calendar-day[tabindex="0"]'
      >
        <DateRangePanel
          value={value}
          confirm={confirm}
          presets={presetList}
          today={today}
          todayProp={todayProp}
          locale={locale}
          format={format}
          min={min}
          max={max}
          disabledDates={disabledDates}
          calendarProps={calendarProps}
          onCommit={commit}
          onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
          applyLabel={applyLabel}
          cancelLabel={cancelLabel}
          presetsLabel={presetsLabel}
          pendingLabel={pendingLabel}
        />
      </PickerPanel>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/date-picker/date-range-presets.ts`

```ts
import { addDays, addMonths, endOfMonth, startOfDay, startOfMonth } from '../calendar/date-utils';
import type { DateRange } from '../calendar/selection';

/** A shortcut in the range picker's presets column. */
export interface DateRangePreset {
  label: string;
  /** The range to select, computed from "today" so it is never stale. */
  range: (today: Date) => { from: Date; to: Date };
}

/** Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, This month, Last month, This year. */
export const defaultDateRangePresets: DateRangePreset[] = [
  { label: 'Today', range: (t) => ({ from: startOfDay(t), to: startOfDay(t) }) },
  { label: 'Yesterday', range: (t) => ({ from: addDays(startOfDay(t), -1), to: addDays(startOfDay(t), -1) }) },
  { label: 'Last 7 days', range: (t) => ({ from: addDays(startOfDay(t), -6), to: startOfDay(t) }) },
  { label: 'Last 30 days', range: (t) => ({ from: addDays(startOfDay(t), -29), to: startOfDay(t) }) },
  { label: 'This month', range: (t) => ({ from: startOfMonth(t), to: endOfMonth(t) }) },
  {
    label: 'Last month',
    range: (t) => {
      const prev = addMonths(startOfMonth(t), -1);
      return { from: prev, to: endOfMonth(prev) };
    },
  },
  { label: 'This year', range: (t) => ({ from: new Date(t.getFullYear(), 0, 1), to: new Date(t.getFullYear(), 11, 31) }) },
];

/** True when a range has both ends. */
export const isCompleteRange = (r: DateRange | null | undefined): r is { from: Date; to: Date } => !!r?.from && !!r.to;
```

### `ui/components/date-picker/picker-panel.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useRef, type FocusEvent, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { FloatingContent, type FloatingContentProps } from '../popover/floating-content';

const FOCUSABLE =
  'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]):not([type="hidden"]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

export interface PickerPanelProps
  extends Omit<FloatingContentProps, 'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'onOpened' | 'returnFocusRef' | 'skipFocusReturnRef'> {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** The field the panel hangs from. Clicks on it never count as "outside". */
  anchorRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  /** Gets focus back when the panel closes. Default: the anchor. */
  returnFocusRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
  /** What receives focus when the panel opens. Default: the first focusable element. */
  focusSelector?: string;
  /** Runs after focus has moved in (scroll a list to its selection here). */
  onOpened?: (panel: HTMLDivElement) => void;
}

/**
 * The floating surface shared by DatePicker, DateRangePicker and TimePicker:
 * a non-modal dialog in the top layer under the field. Esc and an outside
 * click close it, tabbing out closes it, and focus returns to the field.
 */
export const PickerPanel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, PickerPanelProps>(function PickerPanel(
  {
    open,
    onOpenChange,
    anchorRef,
    returnFocusRef,
    focusSelector,
    onOpened,
    placement = 'bottom-start',
    offset = 6,
    className,
    onBlur,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);
  const skipFocusReturn = useRef(false);

  useDismiss(open, [panelRef, anchorRef], (reason) => {
    // An outside click already put focus where the person clicked
    skipFocusReturn.current = reason === 'outside';
    onOpenChange(false);
  });

  return (
    <FloatingContent
      ref={ref}
      open={open}
      anchorRef={anchorRef}
      placement={placement}
      offset={offset}
      role="dialog"
      tabIndex={-1}
      className={cn('ui-picker-panel', className)}
      returnFocusRef={returnFocusRef ?? anchorRef}
      skipFocusReturnRef={skipFocusReturn}
      onOpened={(panel) => {
        const target = panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>(focusSelector ?? FOCUSABLE) ?? panel.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE) ?? panel;
        target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        onOpened?.(panel);
      }}
      onBlur={(e: FocusEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        // Tabbing out of a non-modal panel closes it (focus stays where it went)
        const next = e.relatedTarget as Node | null;
        if (next && !e.currentTarget.contains(next) && !anchorRef.current?.contains(next)) {
          skipFocusReturn.current = true;
          onOpenChange(false);
        }
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </FloatingContent>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-media-query.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

/**
 * Track a CSS media query. `false` on the server and during hydration, so
 * markup always matches; it updates right after mount and on change.
 *   const wide = useMediaQuery('(min-width: 640px)');
 */
export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean {
  const subscribe = useCallback(
    (onChange: () => void) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.matchMedia) return () => {};
      const mql = window.matchMedia(query);
      mql.addEventListener('change', onChange);
      return () => mql.removeEventListener('change', onChange);
    },
    [query],
  );
  const getSnapshot = () => (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia(query).matches : false);
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, () => false);
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/date-picker.css`

```css
/* DatePicker / DateRangePicker --------------------------------------------
   Also home of the two pieces TimePicker shares: .ui-picker-field and .ui-picker-panel.

   <div class="ui-picker-field ui-datepicker [ui-picker-field-sm|lg]" data-state="open|closed" data-disabled data-invalid>
     <button class="ui-picker-trigger" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded>
       <svg class="ui-picker-icon"> <span class="ui-picker-value" [data-placeholder]>Nov 24, 2026</span>
     </button>
     or, typeable: <input class="ui-picker-input">
     <button class="ui-input-action" aria-label="Clear date">…</button>
     <input type="hidden" name="due" value="2026-11-24">
     <div class="ui-floating ui-picker-panel" popover="manual" data-state>…<div class="ui-calendar">…</div></div>
   </div>

   Range panel: .ui-daterange-panel > .ui-daterange
     .ui-daterange-presets > .ui-daterange-preset[aria-pressed]
     .ui-daterange-main > .ui-calendar + .ui-daterange-footer (summary, Cancel, Apply)
   Sizes are the same CSS variables as Input (--ui-input-h / -fs / -px / -r).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  /* ---- Field: looks like an Input ------------------------------------- */
  .ui-picker-field {
    --ui-input-bg: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-input-border);
    border-radius: var(--ui-input-r, var(--radius-md));
    background-color: var(--ui-input-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--ui-input-fs, var(--text-base));
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-picker-field {
    --ui-input-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-picker-field-sm { --ui-input-h: 2rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-sm); --ui-input-px: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-picker-field-lg { --ui-input-h: 2.75rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-md); --ui-input-px: 1rem; --ui-input-r: var(--radius-lg); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-picker-field:hover:not([data-disabled], [data-invalid], [data-state="open"]) {
      --ui-input-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }

  /* Open, or keyboard focus on the trigger / typing in the input */
  .ui-picker-field[data-state="open"] {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-picker-field:has(> .ui-picker-input:focus) {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-picker-field:has(> .ui-picker-trigger:focus-visible) {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-picker-field[data-invalid] { --ui-input-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-picker-field[data-invalid][data-state="open"],
  .ui-picker-field[data-invalid]:has(> .ui-picker-input:focus),
  .ui-picker-field[data-invalid]:has(> .ui-picker-trigger:focus-visible) {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent);
  }

  .ui-picker-field[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  /* Trigger: the whole field is the button */
  .ui-picker-trigger {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 0%;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding-inline: var(--ui-input-px, 0.75rem);
    border: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-picker-trigger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-picker-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-picker-value {
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ui-picker-value[data-placeholder] { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  /* Typeable input */
  .ui-picker-input {
    flex: 1 1 0%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding-inline: var(--ui-input-px, 0.75rem) 0.5rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-picker-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-picker-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-picker-field > .ui-input-action[data-state="open"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }

  /* iOS Safari zooms the page when a focused field is under 16px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-picker-field { font-size: 1rem; }
  }

  /* ---- Panel: shared by every picker ---------------------------------- */
  .ui-picker-panel {
    width: max-content;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-picker-panel[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-picker-panel[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }
  /* Narrow touch screens: shrink the day cells so seven columns fit */
  @media (max-width: 22.5rem) {
    .ui-picker-panel .ui-calendar { --ui-cal-cell: calc((100vw - 3.5rem) / 7); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .ui-picker-panel[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-fade-in var(--ui-duration-fast) linear both; }
  }

  /* ---- Range panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .ui-daterange { display: flex; }
  .ui-daterange-main { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

  .ui-daterange-presets {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    gap: 0.125rem;
    min-width: 9.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-daterange-preset {
    height: 2rem;
    padding-inline: 0.625rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    white-space: nowrap;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-daterange-preset[aria-pressed="true"] {
    background-color: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-daterange-preset:focus-visible { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 70%, transparent); }
  .ui-daterange-preset:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-daterange-preset:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-daterange-preset { height: 2.75rem; }
  }

  .ui-daterange-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-daterange-summary {
    flex: 1 1 0%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .ui-daterange-summary:not([data-empty]) { color: var(--ui-foreground); }

  /* Phones: presets become a scrolling row above the calendar */
  @media (max-width: 39.99rem) {
    .ui-daterange { flex-direction: column; }
    .ui-daterange-presets {
      flex-direction: row;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      /* the row never widens the panel: the calendar decides the width */
      contain: inline-size;
      border-inline-end: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    .ui-daterange-presets::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .ui-daterange-preset { flex-shrink: 0; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Due date** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/date-picker/due-date.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { startOfDay } from '@/ui/components/calendar';
import { DatePicker } from '@/ui/components/date-picker';
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';

export default function DatePickerDueDate() {
  const today = useMemo(() => startOfDay(new Date()), []);
  const [due, setDue] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  // Payment runs only on weekdays
  const weekend = (d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6;

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <Field required>
        <Label>Due date</Label>
        <DatePicker
          value={due}
          onValueChange={setDue}
          min={today}
          disabledDates={weekend}
          placeholder="Pick a due date"
          name="due"
        />
        <FieldHint>
          {due
            ? `Northwind will be reminded the day before ${due.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', day: 'numeric' })}.`
            : 'Payments run on weekdays only.'}
        </FieldHint>
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```
